phase_prompt.summary: Default state of Heaven and Earth, showcasing the full integration of terrestrial stonework and celestial dome.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: In the default state, Heaven and Earth presents a colossal stone citadel with a polished obsidian spire, basalt columns etched with glowing Ethiopian hieroglyphs, crystalline spires refracting light, a sky dome swirling with nebula‑like clouds and runic sensors, living vines pulsing green light, all rendered photorealistically with tactile textures and cinematic lighting
